sketch:
Observe: SVG disk with a marker on the rim moving at constant angular
speed ω. Student sets radius R and ω; v = Rω tangent and centripetal
a = v²/R = Rω² arrows redraw at every instant, always perpendicular.
Experiment: 3 seeded (target v, target a) pairs; student picks R, ω
to hit both. Evaluate: v and a arrows hidden; student sets R, ω from
target numeric v, a alone. Wrinkle: emphasises a ≠ 0 despite |v|
constant — targets a common misconception.
